metadata.cache_condition: WARM OS page cache. No cold-cache measurement is made or claimed.
metadata.timing_notes: Only store calls are timed. Percentiles are nearest-rank (same code as V0/V1/V2). Flush boundaries are observed by wrapping the store instance's flush and lsm_store.sstable.write_sstable; no production code is changed. A flush-triggering operation is a put/delete that finds memtable bytes >= the limit and flushes before applying itself; its latency includes the whole flush. Raw per-operation latencies are not stored except for flush-triggering operations (one record per flush); percentiles of all, non-flush and flush-triggering writes are computed in-process. open_recovery is the first KVStore(path) after close() in the same process; open_components repeats the open steps with the module's own functions. Read-work counting, the per-table cost decomposition and the index-memory (tracemalloc) pass are untimed and run after every timed phase of the run they belong to (read-work counting runs between the timed GETs and the timed overwrites, as in V2).
